jobs.title: 留一碗面
jobs.subtitle: 醒来以后，还有一碗热面

settings.caption: Warm acoustic indie chamber instrumental, D major 72 bpm 4/4. Begin on the first beat with a hummable four-note felt-piano motif, D E A F sharp, syncopated short short long response. Midrange plucked nylon guitar echoes the pianist, simple steady upright bass, quiet brushes. A bowl set down in the lamplight, relief after a bad dream. A clear lead melody, a changing answer every eight bars, tender and memorable, gently confident. Music from first second, recurring steady four-bar phrases, active consonant tail. Small live room, healthy headroom, no vocals or narration.

jobs.title: 留白里的「何」
jobs.subtitle: 抄到「何」字时，笔尖停了一下

settings.caption: Instrumental felt-piano and cello chamber underscore. Warm B minor against relative D major, 72 bpm, 4/4. First beat is a defined close-miked four-note piano theme, D E A F sharp. Repeat recognizable theme with two-note cello answer and soft muted guitar pulse. Clear midrange; legible melody over reading; no huge spaces, no intro silence, no fade before the final phrase. Considered and gently confident like an author finding his own words, not mournful. Natural room, generous peak headroom, no voice, no percussion builds.

jobs.title: 从这里上去
jobs.subtitle: 山路上的背书声，栏杆边认出故人

settings.caption: Instrumental indie acoustic theme for a Chinese narrative game set on a mountain walkway: first climbing alone to get his breath back, then a group of high-schoolers recites verses on the steps and recognizes friends. Present, youthful, lightly windblown; affectionate with a little ache, no triumphant fanfare. D major, 4/4, steady 92 bpm. Open with a catchy four-note picked-guitar line D–E–A–F sharp, using short short held resolve and a clear answer, place it in the foreground early like the first little tune the player remembers. Warm strummed guitar, felt piano or soft mallets, running bass and a barely brushed snare enter gradually. One instrumental lead at a time, mostly simple rhythmic sentences, conversational pauses. Groove should function at a low volume over reading. Light lifts after every 8 bars, breathable ending turnaround and smooth loop potential. No vocals, no busy hi-hats, no trailer drums. Deliver a complete underscore with active gentle phrasing from start through the last measures. Record with ample digital headroom. The outro may thin out but should keep its pulse and pitch until the end, without a long tail of silence.

jobs.title: 半规落日
jobs.subtitle: 快门轻响时，最后一缕金光没入山脊

settings.caption: Instrumental ending theme for a literary visual novel, a final group photograph on a crowded mountain platform overlooking a river at sunset. Clear, luminous, bittersweet and human, the world keeps going. Set 72 bpm, 4/4, D major. Quiet felt piano immediately reprises a recognizable short-short-held-answer melody D–E–A–F sharp from earlier rooms, in a slightly higher register, with simple warm string quartet answering. Understated plucked guitar, a smooth slow swell of human chamber strings at phrase endings, no percussion in the foreground. One singable melody with a real memorable entrance, then ease into air for distant wind and the quiet photo moment. Sustain a feeling of life and youth without bombast. Delicate optimistic color, soft but defined midrange, measured dynamics, loopable instrumental tail, no vocals, no big finale crash. Deliver a complete underscore with active gentle phrasing from start through the last measures. Record with ample digital headroom. The outro may thin out but should keep its pulse and pitch until the end, without a long tail of silence.
